stories.new_fact: BLS released August CPI, showing a 0.4% monthly increase, while the prior PPI report showed a different inflation mix.
stories.new_takeaway: The Fed setup is no longer a clean soft-inflation story; consumer prices, energy and payroll data must be read together.
stories.why_now: The August CPI release arrived September 11 before the September 15-16 Fed meeting.
stories.previous_coverage: September 10 covered PPI relief; this is a new primary CPI release with a different policy and household takeaway.
stories.uncertainty: Energy may explain part of the monthly rise, and market rates may fade or amplify the report before the Fed meeting.
stories.watch: Watch the 10-year Treasury yield and Fed reaction before the September 15-16 meeting.

stories.new_fact: Local reporting described Ohio's state-budget change raising many local referendum signature thresholds from 10% to 35% of voters in the last gubernatorial election, affecting a Worthington redevelopment challenge.
stories.new_takeaway: Central Ohio development opponents may need to intervene earlier in planning and zoning because post-approval referendum leverage is weaker.
stories.why_now: The local report surfaced September 10 and the threshold now affects an active Central Ohio development challenge.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent Columbus segments covered cameras, schools and data centers; this is a different civic-process and development-control angle.
stories.uncertainty: A separate proposal could lower the threshold, and local charter provisions may alter the impact in individual cities.
stories.watch: Watch whether lawmakers lower the threshold to 20% and whether Central Ohio cities revise local referendum rules.

stories.new_fact: Fannie Mae's September 9 lender letter made VantageScore 4.0 broadly available to approved lenders effective immediately, with DU, credit-reporting and delivery requirements.
stories.new_takeaway: The operational challenge is not announcing new credit access; it is keeping score-model ordering, pricing, underwriting and delivery consistent across channels.
stories.why_now: The lender letter became effective September 9 and had not been used in a prior episode.
stories.previous_coverage: September 7 discussed the earlier scoring directive; this segment covers Fannie Mae's concrete implementation mechanics.
stories.uncertainty: Freddie Mac matching detail, lender overlays and later Selling Guide text may determine how fast broad lender use actually occurs.
stories.watch: Watch Freddie Mac implementation detail and lender overlays before production rollout.

stories.new_fact: Truist said AI Call Summaries are deployed across care centers and have saved more than 36,000 hours from reduced manual note-taking.
stories.new_takeaway: Bank-AI evaluation should pair productivity savings with downstream defects, complaint outcomes and reviewability before treating summaries as reliable system records.
stories.why_now: The company disclosure is dated September 10 and creates a new production ledger row.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent bank-AI sections covered OpenAI financial services, JPMorganChase and Better; this is a new institution and consumer-servicing lane.
stories.uncertainty: Truist did not disclose call-summary error rates, complaint outcomes, customer satisfaction movement or audit defect baselines.
stories.watch: Watch for quality metrics, audit findings or expansion to other client-contact workflows.
stories.ledger_row_changed: Truist - lane 1 consumer servicing - new production row with company-claim evidence and a 36,000-hours-saved productivity metric.

stories.new_fact: Anthropic published a September misuse report describing disrupted activity from December 2025 through August 2026 and more agentic misuse patterns.
stories.new_takeaway: The frontier safety question is shifting from prompts and content filters toward agentic orchestration, supply-chain controls and post-market threat reporting.
stories.why_now: The Anthropic report was published September 11 and had not been covered in the prior seven episodes.
stories.previous_coverage: Recent frontier segments covered Gemini Cyber, OpenAI Navier-Stokes and ChatGPT Images; this is a new safety/security item.
stories.uncertainty: The public evidence is lab-reported threat intelligence, not independent replication, and the exact case details are necessarily incomplete.
stories.watch: Watch whether other frontier labs publish comparable misuse reports and whether enterprises make them vendor-risk requirements.
stories.frontier_bar: Safety and security finding; lab-reported misuse and disruption evidence with agentic workflow implications.
